# docbuild

Utilities for building the Manim documentation.

For more information about the Manim documentation building, see:

- [Manim Development Process](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/contributing/development.html), specifically the `Documentation`
  bullet point under [Polishing Changes and Submitting a Pull Request](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/contributing/development.html#polishing-changes-and-submitting-a-pull-request)
- [Adding Documentation](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/contributing/docs.html)

- [autoaliasattr_directive](autoaliasattr_directive/INDEX.md) — A directive for documenting type aliases and other module-level attributes.
- [autocolor_directive](autocolor_directive/INDEX.md) — A directive for documenting colors in Manim.
